name: lean-reverses-fence-key-order
find: 0 < position ∧ position ≤ lastPosition ∧ time ≤ lastTime ∧ keyIncreases = true
replace: 0 < position ∧ position ≤ lastPosition ∧ time ≤ lastTime ∧ keyIncreases = false

name: lean-stream-clears-tombstone
find: if deleting then { k with deleted := true } else k
replace: if deleting then { k with deleted := true } else { k with deleted := false }

name: verus-stream-seals-at-equal-epoch

ensures out == (
        ((a matches Some((ae, an)) && ae == epoch && an >= at)
            && (b matches Some((be, bn)) && be == epoch && bn >= at))
        || ((a matches Some((ae, an)) && ae == epoch && an >= at)
            && (c matches Some((ce, cn)) && ce == epoch && cn >= at))
        || ((b matches Some((be, bn)) && be == epoch && bn >= at)
            && (c matches Some((ce, cn)) && ce == epoch && cn >= at))
    )
